song: 68 - Gypsy Woman (She's Homeless) (La Da Dee La Da Da) (Basement Boy Strip To The Bone Mix)
title: ultraviolet house drop
story: Gypsy Woman at 120 bpm, not the tracker's 143.5: the kick is on every beat (onsets 4-10, centroid 0.16-0.21) and the bright open hats sit on every off-beat (centroid 0.25-0.37). The build 5786-6144 escalates the kick shake one step per bar under a slow depth push and a hue sway per bar; at 6157 the room cuts to the mirrored station, the contrast opens, and the prominent kicks (6170, 6234, 6618 as top, the rest as medium) flash the lamp down with a zoom punch. After the drop the hats sweep the room on every off-beat, the camera cuts mirrored every two bars and sways once per bar.
